note: Shared Phase 1 topic catalog. Assignments are keyword/part rules, provisional until reviewed. Different agencies' rules stay separate evidence records under one topic. A topic match is evidence discovery, never applicability.

topics.label: Common equity tier 1 capital
topics.description: CET1 definition, minimum ratio, deductions and adjustments.
topics.coverage_note: 12 CFR 3, 217, 324 acquired as of the eCFR issue date.

topics.label: Additional tier 1 and tier 2 capital
topics.description: Components and criteria for AT1 and tier 2 instruments.

topics.label: Risk-weighted assets and risk weights
topics.description: Standardized and advanced approaches risk weighting.

topics.label: Leverage ratios
topics.description: Tier 1 leverage ratio and supplementary leverage ratio.

topics.label: Community bank leverage ratio framework
topics.description: CBLR qualifying criteria, election, grace period.
topics.coverage_note: 12 CFR 3.12, 217.12, 324.12 acquired; Federal Register final rule 2026-08298 acquired.

topics.label: Capital buffers and surcharges
topics.description: Capital conservation buffer, countercyclical buffer, GSIB surcharge, stress capital buffer.

topics.label: Liquidity coverage ratio
topics.description: LCR requirement, HQLA, net cash outflows.
topics.coverage_note: 12 CFR 249 (Federal Reserve Board) is acquired. That evidence does not establish coverage of the missing OCC (12 CFR 50) and FDIC (12 CFR 329) liquidity coverage ratio sources. Which regulator's rule governs a given bank is not inferred here.

topics.label: Net stable funding ratio
topics.description: NSFR requirement, available and required stable funding.
topics.coverage_note: 12 CFR 249 subpart K (Federal Reserve Board) is acquired. That evidence does not establish coverage of the missing OCC (12 CFR 50) and FDIC (12 CFR 329) net stable funding ratio sources. Which regulator's rule governs a given bank is not inferred here.

topics.label: Enhanced prudential standards and categories
topics.description: Regulation YY categories, applicability thresholds, stress testing and capital planning.
topics.coverage_note: 12 CFR 252 acquired; Category determinations depend on bank facts not held here.

topics.label: BSA/AML program, CIP and suspicious activity reporting
topics.description: Bank Secrecy Act program rules, customer identification, SAR, CTR, recordkeeping.
topics.coverage_note: 31 CFR 1010 and 1020 acquired; other BSA parts, FinCEN guidance and agency BSA rules not acquired.

topics.label: Payment stablecoin issuers (GENIUS Act implementation)
topics.description: Rulemaking implementing the GENIUS Act for payment stablecoin issuers.
topics.coverage_note: Federal Register proposals and the OCC final rule acquired; no stablecoin text exists in current eCFR baseline parts acquired.

topics.label: U.S. GAAP / FASB ASC
topics.description: Accounting recognition and measurement under the FASB Codification.
topics.coverage_note: FASB ASC text is not ingested; the source-usage route is unresolved. Regulatory capital rules that mention CECL are a separate source class.

topics.label: State banking law
topics.description: State statutes and administrative rules for state-chartered institutions.
topics.coverage_note: No state or territorial source has been acquired (Phase 1 step P1.5).

topics.label: Call Report and regulatory reporting
topics.description: FFIEC Call Report forms and instructions, FR Y reports.
topics.coverage_note: Form and instruction text not acquired; only Federal Register information-collection notices are in the corpus.

topics.label: Prompt corrective action and capital categories
topics.description: Well capitalized and other PCA categories.
topics.coverage_note: PCA rules sit in 12 CFR 6, 208, 324 subpart H; only 324 subpart H is within acquired parts.
